text: No tree-cover loss occurred on this asset after 2020. The analysis, covering 2021–2025, detected no stand-replacing events ≥0.5 ha within the asset boundary. While 43.3 ha (11.55%) of the asset was classified as forest in 2020, no subsequent loss was observed. The data sources (Hansen GFC and JRC GFC2020) confirm stability, though changes smaller than 0.5 ha or at edges might be missed. The asset remains fully observable, with no compliance or regulatory findings.
